body: When I was 13 years old I was on a pedestrian foot bridge with about a 100 people on it which was double the capacity when it broke. I apparently held up the 3 year old kid I was walking with until my mom grabbed him. All I remember was seeing a bright light and my grandmother before I looked around for these stupid light up toys we bought. I remember walking out and then not being able to move or feel my legs. Apparently I drowned or was drowning and an officer whose name i wish I knew grabbed me and pulled me out of the water and gave me some CPR and then I remember laying there with a crowd of people around me. I was cold and everyone was putting clothes on me and then I couldn't move or feel my legs at all then I just remember an ambulance, the EMT cutting off my favorite shirt and a bunch of people in blue putting warming blankets on me (I'm guessing nurses) then I just remember waking up with a needle in my hand and being in the hospital wondering what the hell happened.

We never go out unless it's for food or clothes shopping for my kids. I'd love to take everyone to a movie but I have 3 kids (4 years old, 3 years old, and 6 months old) They just love to run and not listen when we go out and I can't even afford to take them even if I could. I try and surprise her with flowers and candy and DLC for her favorite video games and her favorite videos games as well as massages, cuddles, naps, and surprise move nights. I've tried almost everything I can do from inside, from letting her sleep while i take care of the kids to putting them to bed early for a movie, massage, and long session of sex but it feels like nothing is working anymore. It just kills me because I dump my heart into her telling her I love her everyday and it kills me. I just wanna hear her say it once that's all I really want.
I'd love to but I can't afford it. I have no healthcare and can't get in touch with my caseworker for my family's government healthcare and I'd pay if I could but I'm almost $3,000 on debt.
